products.name: D-Series
products.manufacturerNote: Manufactured by Holophane (UK). Lumen Method is the exclusive Holophane specification agent for Australia.
products.tagline: Post-top LED area luminaire family built around Holophane's Extreme Cutoff Optics — engineered to virtually eliminate backlight spill beyond the boundary line, across three body sizes.
products.summary: D-Series is Holophane's answer to light trespass. Specialised black light engines, integrated specular reflectors and light-absorbing backlight shields work together to virtually eliminate spill light behind the fitting, while maintaining full task-area performance in front of it — dedicated Right/Left Corner Cutoff and Backlight Control optics make it the range of choice for boundary-sensitive sites. Available across three body sizes (DSX0, DSX1, DSX2) covering 2,000–50,000 delivered lumens, with ZD4i-ready smart control compatibility throughout.

backlightControl.heading: Extreme backlight control
backlightControl.body: D-Series' Extreme Cutoff Optics address light trespass at the source. Specialised point-source black light engines, integrated specular reflectors and dedicated light-absorbing backlight shields work together to virtually eliminate spill light behind the fitting, while maintaining full task-area performance in front of it — built for sites where a property boundary, residential interface or dark-sky requirement limits how far light can travel.
points: Point-source black light engines with integrated specular reflectors remove scattered refraction, directing light only where it's needed
Dedicated light-absorbing backlight shields provide additional control without sacrificing luminaire efficiency
LEDs aren't visible from behind the fitting, reducing glare when viewed from the rear

products.summary: R-Line is Holophane's slim-profile LED street luminaire, covering 4,000–19,000 delivered lumens across eleven optical distributions from Type II long & narrow through Type III and Type IV spreads. products.name: Pebble
products.manufacturerNote: Manufactured by Holophane (UK). Lumen Method is the exclusive Holophane specification agent for Australia.
products.tagline: Light shaped for comfort, people and environment.
products.summary: Pebble is a brand-new addition to the Holophane range — a post-top area luminaire built from the ground up around visual comfort, and a Build Back Better Gold Award winner. At its centre is a recessed Comfort Optic paired with Holophane's PrismaLED diffusion technology, blending the six-module LED array into a single soft, evenly lit surface instead of six individual points of glare. The optic is fully rotatable and available across five distributions, from a tight Symmetric spread to Forward Throw Extra, and the recessed design keeps ULOR at a flat 0% for genuine dark-sky compliance. Pebble ships in three mounting configurations — Post-top, Side-entry and Cradle-mount — so one luminaire family covers pathways, plazas, car parks and campus routes without changing specification. A single-fixing replaceable optical pod and a thermally engineered aluminium housing keep it serviceable in the field, and it's ready to integrate with Holophane's HOLOSOne wireless controls for daylight, presence and time-based operation. Covering 3,100–20,000 delivered lumens, it's patent-pending — genuinely new technology, not a reskin of an existing range.

backlightControl.heading: Light shaped for visual comfort
backlightControl.body: Behind Pebble's soft, even glow is a carefully engineered optical system. Six individual LED modules sit behind Holophane's PrismaLED diffusion lenses, blending what would normally be six distinct points of glare into a single luminous surface — all while the recessed optical architecture keeps the light source positioned deeper within the housing, out of the direct line of sight at typical pedestrian viewing angles. The result is a fitting that looks as comfortable to be near as the light it produces.
points: PrismaLED diffusion blends the six-module LED array into one soft, evenly lit surface instead of six individual points of glare
Recessed optical architecture positions the light source deeper within the luminaire, reducing glare and improving visual comfort at pedestrian viewing angles
A single-fixing, interchangeable optical POD carries the Comfort Optic across all five distributions, simplifying servicing and future reconfiguration in the field
